messages.subject: marginal totals in dcast()
parts:
Hi

 

We have a challenge with a whole bunch of datasets that need summaries (sum, mean and length) calculated for all combinations of a bunch of dimensions, including the marginal totals.  A reproducible example below shows that dcast() does nearly exactly what I want, but it doesn’t give the marginal totals of all dimensions against all the combinations of the other dimensions.  For example, in my example, there is no value calculated for VarA==(all) & VarB == “k” & VarC == (all).  It has a sort of hierarchical behaviour governing its use of (all) which means not all combinations are calculated.

 

Two questions:

1. is this how dcast() is meant to behave?

2. How, other than a bunch of Fortran-style nested loops to calculate the summaries one row at a time and append them, can I get the desired result?

 

Thanks for any pointers

 

n <- 1000

Test <- data.frame(

                     VarA = sample(letters[1:2], n, replace=TRUE),

                     VarB = sample(letters[11:12], n, replace=TRUE), 

                     VarC = sample(LETTERS[11:12], n, replace=TRUE),

                     Value = rnorm(n))

 

dcast(Test, VarA + VarB + VarC ~., sum, value.var="Value", margins = TRUE)

 

 

# which gives:

 

    VarA  VarB  VarC          NA

1      a     k     K   4.3715292

2      a     k     L   0.4563981

3      a     k (all)   4.8279273

4      a     l     K   1.9714900

5      a     l     L  -0.1055731

6      a     l (all)   1.8659169

7      a (all) (all)   6.6938442

8      b     k     K -13.7843109

9      b     k     L   1.2389731

10     b     k (all) -12.5453378

11     b     l     K  15.4556702

12     b     l     L  12.6843769

13     b     l (all)  28.1400471

14     b (all) (all)  15.5947093

15 (all) (all) (all)  22.2885535

 

 

Peter Ellis

messages.author: f6bc10d84e92474a
messages.subject: RE: marginal totals in dcast()
parts:
Ok, we worked out an answer ourselves:

 

melt(acast(Test, VarA ~ VarB ~ VarC, sum, value.var="Value", margins = TRUE))

 

I’m still curious about how/why dcast() doesn’t give the same result though.

 

Cheers

PE
